wins.label: Q1 EPS beat and revenue in line
wins.evidence: delivering revenue in line and EPS above our guidance

wins.label: Strong AI PC momentum and demand
wins.evidence: Core Ultra ramp, led by Meteor Lake, continues to accelerate beyond our original expectation, with units expected to double sequentially in Q2

wins.label: Foundry customer wins and pipeline
wins.evidence: signed another meaningful customer on Intel 18A, bringing our total to 6...strong pipeline of nearly 50 test chips

wins.label: Government support and CHIPS Act funding
wins.evidence: single largest award from the CHIPS and Science Act of more than $45 billion of proposed grants, tax incentives and loans

wins.label: Process technology leadership progress
wins.evidence: Intel 20A...begins production ramp in the second half of this year...Intel 18A...1.0 PDK this quarter

risks.label: First half demand weaker than expected
risks.evidence: first half trends are modestly weaker than we originally anticipated

risks.label: Foundry operating losses continuing
risks.evidence: The foundry P&L will remain challenged through the year, and we expect operating margins to trough in 2024

risks.label: Supply constraints limiting AI PC growth
risks.evidence: Q2 client revenue is constrained by wafer-level assembly supply, which is impacting our ability to meet demand

risks.label: Data center share stabilization uncertain
risks.evidence: We continue to expect share trends to stabilize this year before improving in 2025

risks.evidence: inventory headwinds impacting Mobileye, Altera and our 5G customers
